dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: Hello! Is there anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: I'm a new member of the Gardes. Call me Charlene.

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: And if you can't remember the name, just go with "hey," "you," or "newbie," or whatever. Pleased to be at your service!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I probably shouldn't use all those names...

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: Huh, is that a problem? I mean, the important thing is the incident details, not my title, right?

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: Besides, the less people know our names, the better!

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: A Gardes member's name only ever gets published in The Steambird when something goes wrong, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: See you! Hope I don't see you at the scene of a crime, alright? Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: Uh huh, why not? Whatever happens, happens. I don't need to worry about something that hasn't even happened yet!

dialogues.speaker: Charlene
dialogues.text: Don't you think so? It sounds like a deep philosophy of life, right?
